description.blurb: Eurybates is a carbonaceous asteroid located in the orbit of Jupiter, and is referred to as a Trojan asteroid. Eurybates has a small satellite named Queta, and will be visited by the Lucy mission in August of 2027.
description.more: Eurybates is the first Trojan Asteroid that Lucy will visit, in August of 2027. In January of 2019 the Lucy team learned about the satellite Queta, which is likely around 1 km (0.5 miles) in size.
